allow_large: Owner asked (2026-10-09): a new explore kind in forge.toml for read-only work (explorer role and forge ask), on Haiku 4.5 high by default

amendments.because: Owner (2026-10-09): the read-only model is Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5), not 4.5
amendments.done_when: forge.toml has an explore kind for read-only work, used by the explorer role on both hosts and by forge ask, separate from lite (which keeps a fix's first build round); forge init writes its Claude entry as claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 at high effort and its Codex entry as the current lite Codex entry, and this repo sets the same; a repo without an explore entry keeps using lite for these as today; sync writes the explorer role from it; the coordinator guide describes it; command tests cover a new repo, an earlier-adopted repo without the entry (unchanged behaviour), and the explorer role and forge ask picking the explore entry

why: Read-only Claude work (the explorer subagent role and quick forge ask questions) should run on Haiku 4.5 at high effort (owner, 2026-10-09), but both share forge.toml's lite setting with the first build round of every fix, so it can't change without moving fix implementation to Haiku
